prompt: 故事裡常用 first, next, then, finally 來排順序。哪個字表示「最後」？

wrong.first: first 是「首先」，表示一開始。
wrong.next: next 是「接下來」，表示緊接著的下一步。
wrong.then: then 是「然後」，在中間的步驟用，不是最後。

why: finally 表示故事或步驟的最後。

prompt: 選出正確的順序字：_____, the bear woke up. Then he ate breakfast.
text: _____, the bear woke up. Then he ate breakfast.

wrong.Finally: finally 是最後，但後面還有 Then，所以這裡不是最後。
wrong.Last night: 語意是「昨晚」，不是排序的第一步。
wrong.After that: after that 是「那之後」，前面要先有一件事才用得上。

why: 醒來是第一件事，後面才有 Then，所以用 First。

prompt: 哪一組句子的事件順序最合理？
options: Finally, Tom got up. Then he went to school. First, he ate breakfast.
Tom went to school. Then he got up. Finally, he ate breakfast.
Tom got up. Then he ate breakfast. Finally, he went to school.
answer: Tom got up. Then he ate breakfast. Finally, he went to school.

wrong.Finally, Tom got up. Then he went to sch: Finally 放在開頭很怪，順序字和事情先後對不上。
wrong.Tom went to school. Then he got up. Fina: 先上學才起床，生活順序不合理。

why: 起床、吃早餐、上學是自然的順序，順序字也用對。
tip: 順序字要對上事情先後。
say: Tom got up. Then he ate breakfast. Finally, he went to school.

prompt: 你想跟朋友說這本書的書名。哪一句最自然？
options: The title of this book is Little Fish.
The title of this book are Little Fish.
The name of this book have Little Fish.
answer: The title of this book is Little Fish.

title 只有一個，be 動詞要用 is，不用 are。
have 後面這樣用不通順，表示書名要用 is。

why: title 是書名，單數就用 is。
say: The title of this book is Little Fish.

prompt: 你想問朋友故事裡誰是主角（character），哪一句最合適？

wrong.What is the main character?: 要問「誰」，用 Who；What 是問「什麼東西」。
wrong.Where is the main character?: Where 是問地點，不是問人物是誰。

why: 問人物用 Who，main character 是主角。

prompt: 選出適合的字：The story is about a girl and her dog. The girl is a _____ in the story.
text: The story is about a girl and her dog. The girl is a _____ in the story.

wrong.title: title 是書名，不是故事裡的人物。
wrong.picture: picture 是圖畫，女孩是人物，不是圖畫。

why: 故事裡的人或動物叫 character。
say: The girl is a character in the story.

prompt: 選出合適的字：On the last page, the lost cat comes home. That is the _____ of the story.
text: On the last page, the lost cat comes home. That is the _____ of the story.

wrong.beginning: beginning 是開頭，最後一頁是結尾。
wrong.title: title 是書名，不是故事的結尾。
wrong.author: author 是作者，是寫書的人。

why: 最後一頁發生的是故事的結尾 ending。
say: That is the ending of the story.

options: Yesterday, the rabbit jump over the river.
Yesterday, the rabbit jumped over the river.
Yesterday, the rabbit jumps over the river.
answer: Yesterday, the rabbit jumped over the river.

wrong.Yesterday, the rabbit jump over the rive: Yesterday 表示過去，jump 要加 -ed 變成 jumped。
wrong.Yesterday, the rabbit jumps over the riv: jumps 是現在式，Yesterday 要用過去式 jumped。

why: 繪本常用過去式講故事，Yesterday 要用 jumped。
tip: 說過去的故事，動詞用過去式。
say: Yesterday, the rabbit jumped over the river.

prompt: 「The picture shows a boy under a big tree.」這個圖畫是什麼？
options: 一個男孩爬上一棵大樹。
一棵大樹在男孩的家裡。
一個男孩在一棵大樹下面。
answer: 一個男孩在一棵大樹下面。

wrong.一個男孩爬上一棵大樹。: under 是「在...下面」，不是爬上去。
wrong.一棵大樹在男孩的家裡。: 句子說的是男孩在樹下，不是樹在家裡。

why: under 表示在下面，所以男孩在樹下。
say: The picture shows a boy under a big tree.

wrong.故事的作者是誰？: 問作者是 Who is the author?，這句問的是事件。
wrong.故事是在哪裡發生的？: 問地點是 Where，這句的 next 是「接下來」。

why: next 是接下來，What happens next 就是問下一步。

prompt: 朋友問你這本書好不好看，你想說「我最喜歡結尾」。哪一句最自然？

title 是書名，ending 是結尾，兩個字不能這樣接在一起。
結尾只有一個，不用說 first ending。

why: best 是最，I like ... best 表示最喜歡。

prompt: 哪一句的順序字用得對？
options: Then, the boy opened the box. First he saw a puppy.
Finally, the boy opened the box. Then he saw a puppy.
First, the boy opened the box. Then he saw a puppy.
answer: First, the boy opened the box. Then he saw a puppy.

wrong.Then, the boy opened the box. First he s: Then 放在開頭、First 放在後面，順序搞反了。
wrong.Finally, the boy opened the box. Then he: Finally 是最後，但後面還有 Then，語氣互相矛盾。

why: 先開盒子才會看到小狗，所以 First 在前，Then 在後。
say: First, the boy opened the box. Then he saw a puppy.
